description: Kitezh MCP observability following the Kitezh backend dashboard panel naming and ordering where applicable. Database, cache, user session, and login panels do not apply to this standalone stateless service.

panels.description: 1 means MCP process metrics are arriving in Grafana Cloud; 0 means no MCP telemetry series was found.
panels.title: Availability

panels.description: Age of the latest OTLP process metric sample.
panels.title: Telemetry age

panels.description: Time from process start until the MCP application is ready.
panels.title: Application ready time

panels.description: Time from process start until the application context has started.
panels.title: Application started time

panels.description: Spring Boot HTTP request count uses millisecond-suffixed metric names in this Grafana Cloud stack.
panels.title: HTTP request rate

panels.description: Share of MCP and unmatched HTTP requests that return a 5xx response.
panels.title: HTTP 5xx error rate

panels.description: 1 means MCP process telemetry arrived during the last five minutes; this uses OTLP freshness instead of Prometheus scrape health.
panels.title: Telemetry availability

panels.description: Fraction of MCP and unmatched HTTP responses completed within 250 ms.
panels.title: Responses under 250 ms
HTTP requests by route and status

panels.description: Error and warning log event rates; this panel reports counts, not log contents.

targets.expr: sum by (level) (rate(logback_events_total{service_name="$service",level=~"error|warn"}[5m])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "level", "no events", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Application log events

panels.description: Tool/status labels are bounded; do not add user IDs, tokens, query text, or resource IDs.

targets.expr: sum by (tool, status) (rate(kitezh_mcp_tool_calls_total{service_name="$service"}[5m])) or on() label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "no calls", "__name__", ".*"), "status", "none", "__name__", ".*")

panels.title: Tool calls by outcome

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tool) (rate(kitezh_mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds_milliseconds_bucket{service_name="$service"}[5m]))) / 1000 and (sum by (tool) (rate(kitezh_mcp_tool_call_duration_seconds_milliseconds_count{service_name="$service"}[5m])) > 0)) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "no calls", "__name__", ".*")

sum by (tool, outcome) (rate(kitezh_mcp_kitezh_api_requests_total{service_name="$service",outcome="error"}[5m])) or on() label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "tool", "no errors", "__name__", ".*"), "outcome", "none", "__name__", ".*")

panels.description: Rate of tools/list and tools/call requests, grouped by MCP method.
panels.title: MCP operation rate

panels.description: End-to-end MCP operation latency by protocol method. Tool-specific handler latency remains available in Tool call p95 latency.
panels.title: MCP operation p95 latency

panels.description: Protocol, tool, authorization, validation, timeout, and HTTP failures grouped by MCP method.

targets.expr: sum by (method, error_type) (rate(mcp_server_operation_duration_seconds_milliseconds_count{service_name="$service",error_type!="none"}[5m])) or on() label_replace(label_replace(vector(0), "method", "none", "__name__", ".*"), "error_type", "none", "__name__", ".*")
